[SWS_DM_00967] Support of
UDS
service ReadDTCInformation, Subfunction
0x0A
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04180, RS_Diag_04157, RS_Diag_04067
⌈
If a
DiagnosticReadDTCInformation
of category ’REPORT_SUPPORTED_DTC
exists, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall support subfunction 0x0A (re-
portSupportedDTC) of the UDS service 0x19 ReadDTCInformation according to ISO
14229-1[1].
⌋
